about: The Workbench icons of the TransballGL drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/transballgl.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a thrust ship in a dark cavern towing a glowing energy sphere on its tractor beam) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/transballgl.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. TransballGL-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, TransballGL.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's TransballGL.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, GPL-3.0.txt, the two OFL texts, README-TransballGL.txt and Licences.txt; Data.info is the icon of the data drawers (graphics, sound, maps, mymaps, tutorials, fonts, players, other-players, replays).
